ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

4. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

5. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.

6. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

7. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. goed

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

9. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. blue
   C. quickly
   D. run

11. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. No full stops

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Attitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening to Respond: Attitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Phrasal Verbs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
